title: Accounting Operations & Technical Accounting, Assistant Vice President
description: About the Role iCapital is seeking an experienced and versatile accounting professional to join the Corporate Finance team as an Accounting Operations and Technical Accounting Assistant Vice President. This role will support a broad range of accounting, financial reporting, controls, systems, tax-related initiatives, and special projects. The ideal candidate is a technically strong accountant with a hands-on, operational mindset who is comfortable moving between complex accounting matters and day-to-day execution.   Responsibilities Support technical accounting matters, including researching and applying U.S. GAAP and documenting conclusions for new and complex transactions. Support monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes across Corporate Finance, including accounting, preparing and reviewing account reconciliations and journal entries, and financial statement support. Assist with quarterly and annual financial reporting, financial statement disclosures, and external audit requests, including international audits and the 401(k) audit. Identify opportunities to improve the accuracy, efficiency, and scalability of close and reporting processes, including automation and process improvement across Corporate Finance. Assist with coordination and review of the Company's 409A valuation, stock-based compensation expense forecasting, and cash forecasting related to settlement of RSUs. Support the development, documentation, and execution of the Company's internal control framework, partnering with process owners to document accounting procedures and key controls. Assist with control testing, remediation, and preparation of supporting documentation, helping strengthen processes as iCapital continues to move toward public-company operating and reporting standards. Serve as a key administrator and business partner for finance systems, including FloQast and other accounting and reporting tools, maintaining system configurations, workflows, user access, and supporting documentation. Partner with Accounting, Finance, Tax, Legal, and other stakeholders on system implementations and enhancements. Support tax-related accounting and reporting processes, including coordinating information required for tax provision and compliance activities, and assist with employee and equity-related tax reporting as needed. Coordinate with internal Tax resources and external advisors on reporting requirements. Serve as a flexible resource for complex and cross-functional accounting initiatives, including new transactions, system implementations, process redesigns, acquisitions, and other strategic Finance projects, and take ownership of projects that may not fall cleanly within a traditional accounting function.   Qualifications 4-7 years of relevant accounting experience, with Big Four or other large public accounting experience is preferred Bachelor's degree in Accounting; CPA is strongly preferred Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and financial reporting Experience with internal controls, month-end close, and financial statement reporting Comfortable working with financial systems, large data sets and strong Excel skills Able to research technical accounting issues and translate conclusions into practical accounting processes Strong organizational and project-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities Comfortable operating in a growing organization where responsibilities may evolve over time Technical experience researching an accounting issue and documenting the conclusion Operational experience booking entries, building reconciliations, improving controls, and managing systems Experience with SOX and internal controls   Benefits   The base salary range for this role is $ 110,000 to $ 140,000.  iCapital offers a compensation package which includes salary, equity for all full-time employees, and an annual performance bonus. Employees also receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes an employer matched retirement plan, generously subsidized healthcare with 100% employer paid dental, vision, telemedicine, and virtual mental health counseling, parental leave, and unlimited paid time off (PTO). We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office Monday-Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday. For additional information on iCapital, please visit https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us    X: @icapitalnetwork | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/icapital-network-inc | Awards Disclaimer: https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us/recognition/ iCapital is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. title: Technical Lead – Norm Compliance
description: About Norm Norm builds AI-native professional services firms and the technology that powers them. Our mission is to help expert professionals deliver better work at greater scale. Developing the technology and the firms together lets us rethink how work gets done, how teams operate and what clients can expect. Professional judgment and experience guide what we build, while advances in the technology expand what our firms can deliver. Our shared agentic platform connects that progress across teams and services. Founded in 2023, Norm brings together experts across engineering, research, product, design and professional practice. Our legal and compliance platform serves institutions representing more than $35 trillion in combined assets under management. Norm also powers Norm Law, LLP, an affiliated AI-native law firm whose attorneys advise leading institutions on complex corporate matters. AI Fluency: Norm prefers all team members to be fluent in AI. Successful candidates actively use AI in their day-to-day work to support thinking, creation, and problem-solving. They use it to improve the quality and speed of their work and to continuously refine how work gets done end-to-end. Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate and discuss their AI usage throughout the interview process, including concrete examples of tools, workflows, and outcomes. We look for practical, hands-on experience, not theoretical familiarity. THIS ROLE We are hiring a hands-on Tech Lead for Norm Compliance, the team that owns Norm's compliance platform for asset managers: the product behind marketing and content review at some of the largest financial institutions in the US. You are an IC-style engineer who can also set an engineering roadmap and lead a team; you will lead up to seven engineers, own every technical decision inside the platform, and ship code yourself at least half of the week. The platform has been shipping for years. You will ramp with the engineers who know it best, then set its direction. HOW YOU'LL WORK The team is fully remote in the US and reports to the General Manager of Norm Compliance. You set the platform's technical direction, from architecture and standards to a roadmap you shape with the product manager and the General Manager. The team owns the platform end to end, including the infrastructure it runs on. Day to day you work with a product manager who owns the backlog and our commitments to clients, and with a client engagement/deployment strategy team that owns the relationships: you decide how the work gets done and how long it takes, they decide what we take on and when, and nothing reaches a client without both. The team runs its own on-call. YOU WILL - Own architecture, technical standards and code review for the platform, and contribute production code every week. - Set the engineering roadmap for the platform with the product manager and the General Manager. - Hire, onboard and grow a team of Staff and Senior engineers. - Run on-call escalation. - Answer clients' technical questions, in writing or through meetings, along the client engagement/deployment strategy team. - Learn the platform with the engineers who run it today, ship with their review, then own it. SKILLS & EXPERIENCE - CORE - Bachelor's or Master's in computer science or an equivalent field, or equivalent practical experience - 8+ years building production software, including 3+ years leading a team of four to eight engineers while still shipping code - Python and TypeScript in production; Postgres or similar; AWS - Experience taking over a large codebase built by others and running it - Experience setting and delivering a technical roadmap for a product with enterprise clients - Experience on client calls, answering hard technical questions without over-promising - Clear, brief writing SKILLS & EXPERIENCE - PLUSES - Clients in financial services or another regulated industry - Experience with LLM-backed products, Terraform, or a workflow engine such as Temporal - Experience splitting a release pipeline or a shared repository, or hiring a team from zero WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE - 90 DAYS - You know the platform's architecture and its largest clients, and have shipped with code review from the team - You own the platform's technical decisions and run on-call escalation - The team has run an incident end to end, and you, the team and the product manager have a written way of working COMP AND BENEFITS $220,000 - $290,000 a year plus equity. The range displayed in this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salary for this position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including job-related skills (as uncovered during the interview process), experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed here reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity or benefits. We offer a competitive salary along with equity compensation.
